description: Prepare a project-local development feature tree with provenance and live history.

interface.longDescription: Track features, requirements, provenance and evidence for one local Codex project in a pixel-art live view. Runs locally on macOS 26+ arm64, with separate recording consent and no extra model API, hooks or MCP server. Setup fetches one exact version and SHA-256-pinned native core over public HTTPS. The core remains free for personal and professional local projects. Public Directory admission and clean-Mac trust are not established.

name: evotree
